summary: Frontend-only Playwright test on mobile viewport (390x844) of Menoo Expo web preview. 38/38 checks PASS: bottom tab bar shows the requested 5 icons in the exact order (Accueil, Menus, Courses, Réserves, Profil) with 'Suivi' removed; Home retains 'Mon suivi' and 'Voir mes réserves' cards and /tracking still renders all 6 cards (radar, weekly, budget, energy, objectif, diversité). Menus screen renders 7 days × 3 meals = 21 cards laid out 3-per-row with slot badge / title / time / 0€ badge / green ✓ overlay / swap ↔ overlay. Swap modal opens with 3 alternatives, replacing the meal in the calendar after tap. Tapping a meal navigates to /prep/[mealId]; preparation screen shows progress ('Étape X sur 6'), current step text, minuteur card with Démarrer→Pause countdown and reset. Advancing through steps to the last one turns the CTA into 'Repas confirmé' which navigates back to /(tabs)/meals and increments the confirmed counter (observed 5/21 after confirming lun-din). Courses tab groups items by Carrefour Market / Grand Frais / Monoprix / Biocoop and shows the 3 Substitutions IA cards. Semaine suivante (btn-regen-week) resets and re-renders 21 meals. No crashes, no red screens, no blank routes. Two RN-Web deprecation console warnings (non-blocking) noted below.

issues: Meal card image height is 84px which is fine visually but touch target for the swap ↔ button is 24×24 with hitSlop=6 → effective ~36px; below the 44px iOS guideline. Consider increasing swapBtn size or hitSlop to 12.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted from shadow tokens used across screens. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/tokens.ts (shadow.card/soft). Migrate to boxShadow for web or accept as web-only warning.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a third-party component (e.g., safe-area or expo-image). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional polish) Increase swap ↔ button touch target on meal cards to ≥44px (or add hitSlop 12).
(Optional) Migrate shadow tokens to boxShadow on web to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.

(Nit) During navigation between /tracking and /(tabs)/meals, both screens can remain mounted in the web preview, causing selectors like [data-testid="btn-regen-week"] to match twice in strict mode. Not a functional bug (only one is visible) but tests should scope with .first(). Consider not preserving offscreen tab screens in web build if it grows.
critical_code_review_comments: meals.tsx correctly merges weekOverrides with weeklyPlan and displays confirmed count from both server flag and confirmedMeals map — good pattern.
prep/[mealId].tsx correctly resets timer on step change, pauses on AppState background, and uses replace() so back-nav from /prep does not leak into the stack.
MenooProvider.regenerateWeek clears overrides + confirmations + bumps weekVersion — matches expected behavior of 'Semaine suivante' reset.
Courses screen groups by store using useMemo — efficient. Substitutions IA renders exactly 3 cards from mockData.substitutions.
seed_data_creation: None. Uses in-memory mock data (weeklyPlan, swapAlternatives, shoppingList, substitutions, prepSteps).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified end-to-end: tab-bar reshuffle, 21-meal weekly grid, swap modal, prep pas-à-pas with timer, meal confirmation loop back to Menus, courses grouped by store + Substitutions IA, Home→Tracking navigation. Preview URL: https://stock-meals.preview.emergentagent.com. testIDs are exactly as documented in the review request. No credentials required — no backend flows.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced during this iteration.
